title: Session index manifest
description: The adjacent index-manifest.json for coordinator/index/sessions. This is the accepted watchtower.v1.derived-store $defs.derivedStoreManifest fragment narrowed to storeKind 'sessions'; it defines no new record type. CORRECTION-02's wt-session-index-identity/2, -manifest/2, -commit/2 and -pointer/2 records are withdrawn: the accepted fragment already covers this store, and its storeKind enum already contains 'sessions'.

databaseSchemaVersion.description: Bumped from the rejected CA-16 implementation's version 1 so that a legacy store can never satisfy admission and is rebuilt from journals instead of adopted.

packSealId.description: Session indexes are journal-derived, not pack-derived.

identity.description: The only admitted rebuild source. coordinator-automation.md 9.7 requires a deterministic rebuild from the journal; no derived store, including a previous session index, is an admissible source.

checkpoint.description: Aggregate checkpoint across every indexed session, covering offset, byte length, and continuity digest.

sessions.description: Per-session journal checkpoint at build time, so 9.7 continuity can be verified per session and not only in aggregate.

semanticRoot.description: Produced by src/foundation/storage/semanticRoot.ts computeSemanticRoot over the registry.json logical export. No session-specific root algorithm exists.

counts.description: Row counts per table, from logicalExportCounts.

builtAt.description: Informational, and excluded from semantic identity per coordinator-automation.md 9.3.
